title: A Visit to the City Museum
text:
Our city museum has a new brochure. It is free, and you can get one at the front desk. The brochure shows a map of the museum and its opening hours.

The museum is open from Tuesday to Sunday, from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. On Sunday, it closes at 3 p.m. Children under twelve can enter for free.

questions.text: Where can you get the brochure?
What time does the museum close on Sunday?
Why might a family with young children like this museum?
options: The museum is closed on Sundays
The museum is far from the city

questions.text: What is the main reason to read the brochure before a visit?
options: To plan the visit and know the opening hours

vocabulary.definition: a small booklet that gives information about a place or service
the place in a building where visitors ask for help or information
the times when a place is open for visitors
a drawing that shows the streets or rooms of a place

paragraph_translations: Şehir müzemizin yeni bir broşürü var. Ücretsiz ve danışma masasından alabilirsiniz. Broşürde müzenin haritası ve çalışma saatleri gösteriliyor.
Müze salıdan pazara, sabah 9'dan akşam 5'e kadar açıktır. Pazar günleri saat 3'te kapanır. On iki yaşın altındaki çocuklar ücretsiz girebilir.
